dedupe_keys.name: so2sat pop part 2 elevation and osm patches

description: The TUM So2Sat team publishes Part 2 of its European city population-estimation benchmark in a separate mediaTUM record. Its own page makes ZIP files available under CC BY-SA 4.0 rights. The article says this part contains digital-elevation patches and raw OpenStreetMap inputs for the same city-split benchmark as Part 1. These inputs can help develop spatial population surfaces for urban demand or exposure simulations when joined carefully to the population-labelled patches. A caveat is that the two parts have different licences and file structures; the share-alike terms on this deposit should not be silently replaced by Part 1's CC BY terms. Elevation and map-feature inputs are proxies, not direct household counts. I read the own mediaTUM record and article Data Records without downloading the files, checking the link keys between parts or fitting a model. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
